status.description: Every handoff is decided. PUBLISHED means the first Host-valid reversible proposal was persisted; NO_CHANGE means the current structure was explicitly selected as the working decision.

reason_code.description: Use revision_published for PUBLISHED; source_already_satisfies_handoff, no_grounded_change, or current_structure_selected for NO_CHANGE.

evidence_state.description: Evidence quality is independent from the mandatory working decision and never becomes a per-item workflow blocker.

decision_policy.description: PUBLISHED uses FIRST_HOST_VALIDATED_PROPOSAL; NO_CHANGE uses KEEP_CURRENT_STRUCTURE.
